title: Parrot
card: A newborn African Grey with two side eyes, an ear and a voice. Talk to it, teach it a sound, throw it a pistachio, and watch its brain.
tagline: Two eyes, an ear, a voice, and a brain you watch in 3D
kicker: A MEMORY THAT GROWS EACH TIME IT HEARS
feature: Each sound the parrot hears is a record in Cadence's long-term memory: heard again, the record grows deeper and fades more slowly, and once deep the parrot can say it back. Its brain runs in your browser, ten moments a second.
howTo: Let it hear you, then say a short word a few times while it looks at a thing; watch the Memory tab. Throw it a pistachio after a sound you like. Drag things nearer or behind it. Point at a ? to see what a part does.
promise_test: python parrot/site/tests/test_sound_memory.py && node parrot/site/tests/dsp_parity.mjs && node parrot/site/tests/voice_roundtrip.mjs && python parrot/site/tools/check_page.py --shots <dir>
